name: manual_645bf5
claim: When tracked files contain what would otherwise be an OS-specific absolute home-directory path, use reverse git repo-relative paths instead (../../, ../) resolved from the file's own location within the repo. Never use username-containing placeholders -- they still expose directory structure. The filename alone is sufficient when marked local-only; strip the parent path tree entirely. Standard: repo-relative paths from the file's directory, or ~ for home, or $REPO_ROOT for the repo root. Applies to all tracked files including .agent/memory JSON and markdown.

decisions.notes: Reworded to avoid embedding the literal path-pattern substrings the lesson itself warns against; standardizes on reverse git repo-relative paths.
